subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
statement: The system shall enumerate, per harness, the figures it requires, and shall resolve each required figure for a recorded process to a measured value or an explicit unavailability.
rationale: M2 counts absent figures against a universe; without an enumerated required set, "absent" has no denominator and the metric cannot fail
fit_criterion: for each supported harness the required-figure set is enumerable from the contract and its frozen capability enumeration (FR-2); every required figure in every record resolves to one of the two states
